c-tuulia.title: Review our login and authentication system for weaknesses
c-tuulia.summary: Tuulia Software needs someone to check how people sign in to the payments app and find where it could be broken into.
tasks: Read how sign-in, password reset and sessions work in the payments app and list the weak points
Try the usual attacks on a test copy, such as stolen sessions and guessable reset links, and write down what worked
Agree a short fix list with the developers and help check the first two fixes

c-nordhaul.title: Cut empty runs in our delivery planning
c-nordhaul.summary: Nordhaul Logistics wants to find where trucks leave the depot with space to spare and change how loads are planned.
tasks: Sort last year's route and load data into one table
Find the days and routes where trucks run mostly empty
Propose one change to the dispatch routine and test it for a week

c-kuura.title: Connect our clinic app to patient record systems
c-kuura.summary: Kuura Health Tech needs someone to link its appointment app to the record systems clinics already use, safely.
tasks: Map the data fields our app uses against one record system
Test the connection with made-up patients only
Write a one-page guide for clinic IT staff

c-aurinkovirta.title: Turn solar-site readings into a monthly report
c-aurinkovirta.summary: Aurinkovirta Energy collects readings from 12 solar sites and wants a clear monthly view of which sites lose output.
tasks: Collect the readings from all 12 sites into one table
Spot the sites that lose output and look for patterns
Build a simple dashboard for site managers

c-pikkupeli.title: Build tools that speed up our level design
c-pikkupeli.summary: Pikkupeli Studio wants a developer who makes the designers' slowest steps faster.
tasks: Sit with the level designers for a day and note what slows them down
Build or fix one tool for the slowest step
Ask the designers to use it and change it from their feedback
